dialogues.jp: ──夢だな。

夢を見ている。いや──この感覚は、｛・・・・／見せられ｝
｛・・・／ている｝方、か。
dialogues.en:
I see the familiar view and the familiar color. This pink
road is...... @
dialogues.text:
I see the familiar view and the familiar color. This pink
road is...... @

dialogues.jp:
久方ぶりに、俺のかったるい能力が発動してい
るらしかった。
dialogues.en: the cherry blossom road to my school...
dialogues.text: the cherry blossom road to my school...

dialogues.jp:
あんまり睡眠が深いのか、身体は言うことを聞
かない。為すすべもなく、流されていく。
dialogues.en: "Teehee...... You look sleepy."
dialogues.text: "Teehee...... You look sleepy."

dialogues.jp: 誰かの、夢の世界へと──。

dialogues.en: Who's this? She's smiling and walking beside me.
dialogues.text: Who's this? She's smiling and walking beside me.

dialogues.jp:
見慣れた風景に見慣れた色。桜色が舞うここは
──学園へと続く桜並木か。
dialogues.en: "OH."
dialogues.text: "OH."

dialogues.jp: 誰だ、この人？
dialogues.en: I notice her cat ears. So she's Yoriko-san?
dialogues.text: I notice her cat ears. So she's Yoriko-san?

dialogues.jp: 俺の隣を、楽しげに歩いているが……。
dialogues.en: But why is she wearing school uniform......?
dialogues.text: But why is she wearing school uniform......?

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「桜が凄くて……｛めまい／眩暈｝を起こしそうですね……」
dialogues.en:
"It's full of cherry blossoms...... It makes me feel
dizzy......"
dialogues.text:
"It's full of cherry blossoms...... It makes me feel
dizzy......"

dialogues.jp:
俺の疑問をよそに、頼子さんは目を細める。ゆ
るゆると手を伸ばすとそっと握りしめた。
dialogues.en:
Despite my question, Yoriko narrows her eyes. She reaches
her hand into the air and softly closes it.
dialogues.text:
Despite my question, Yoriko narrows her eyes. She reaches
her hand into the air and softly closes it.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ほらほら、見て下さい」
dialogues.en: "See, see? Look at this."
dialogues.text: "See, see? Look at this."

dialogues.jp:
何だか子供のように｛ほほえ／微笑｝むと、手の平をぱっと
開いた。そこには、何枚かの花びらが。
dialogues.en:
She smiles like a child and openes her hand. There were some
petals in her hand.
dialogues.text:
She smiles like a child and openes her hand. There were some
petals in her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとに、不思議ですよね……」
dialogues.en: "This is really strange......"
dialogues.text: "This is really strange......"

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、また遠い目をする。桜吹雪のその
先には、風見学園の校門があるはずだ。
dialogues.en:
Says she, narrowing her eyes again. Beyond these blowing
cherry blossom petals, there should be the gate of Kazami
Academy.
dialogues.text:
Says she, narrowing her eyes again. Beyond these blowing
cherry blossom petals, there should be the gate of Kazami
Academy.

dialogues.jp:
ふと気が付いた──今まで気が付かなかったの
が、不思議なのだが。
dialogues.en:
Then I notice -- It's strange that I didn't notice it till
now.
dialogues.text:
Then I notice -- It's strange that I didn't notice it till
now.

dialogues.jp: 俺達は、手を繋いでいるようだった。
dialogues.en: It seems like we're holding hands.
dialogues.text: It seems like we're holding hands.

dialogues.jp: （おいおい、こりゃ……）
端から見れば、まるきりカップルじゃないか。
dialogues.en: We completely look like a couple.
dialogues.text: We completely look like a couple.

dialogues.jp:
辺りを見回す。目をこらすのだが、どうにも桜
が強くて、道を見通す事が出来ない。
dialogues.en:
I look around. I try to look through the thickly blowing
cherry blossom petals but I can't see anything.
dialogues.text:
I look around. I try to look through the thickly blowing
cherry blossom petals but I can't see anything.

dialogues.jp: 人が居るのか居ないのか、それが分からない。
dialogues.en: I can't tell if there are people around us or not.
dialogues.text: I can't tell if there are people around us or not.

dialogues.jp:
世界には、俺達二人しか居ないのかもしれない。
あり得る──これは、夢なのだから。
dialogues.en:
Maybe there are only two of us in this world. It could be --
because this is a dream.
dialogues.text:
Maybe there are only two of us in this world. It could be --
because this is a dream.

dialogues.jp:
風景は後ろへ後ろへと流れていく。桜色の空気
を｛か／掻｝き分けて、前へと進んでいく。
dialogues.en:
The viewpoint is flowing backwards. And we are walking
forward through the pink air.
dialogues.text:
The viewpoint is flowing backwards. And we are walking
forward through the pink air.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉さん」
dialogues.en: "Junichi-san."
dialogues.text: "Junichi-san."

dialogues.jp: 穏やかな呼びかけ。
dialogues.en: She calls my name very softly.
dialogues.text: She calls my name very softly.

dialogues.jp: （うん？）
dialogues.en: (Yes?)
dialogues.text: (Yes?)

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……宿題、ちゃんとやってきました？」
dialogues.en: "......Did you do your homework?"
dialogues.text: "......Did you do your homework?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: （……い？　んなの、あったっけ？）
dialogues.en: "......What? Did I have any homework?"
dialogues.text: "......What? Did I have any homework?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ありましたよ……忘れちゃったんですか？　
　数学の授業で、プリントを出されたじゃな
　いですか」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, you did...... Did you forget? In math class, you got a
handout."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, you did...... Did you forget? In math class, you got a
handout."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: （……忘れてた）
dialogues.en: (......I forgot.)
dialogues.text: (......I forgot.)

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「くすくす……怒られますよ」
dialogues.en: "Teehee...... The teacher will be mad."
dialogues.text: "Teehee...... The teacher will be mad."

dialogues.jp:
声は出していないのに、会話は通じているよう
だった。
dialogues.en:
We're not talking out loud but it seems like we understand
each other.
dialogues.text:
We're not talking out loud but it seems like we understand
each other.

dialogues.jp:
きっと、彼女の見ている夢に“俺”が登場して
いるのだろう。
dialogues.en: Maybe I'm in her dream right now.
dialogues.text: Maybe I'm in her dream right now.

dialogues.jp: 「……見せて」
dialogues.en: "......Let me see yours."
dialogues.text: "......Let me see yours."

dialogues.jp: のど元に手を添えて、俺はそう言った。
dialogues.en: I put my hand to my throat and ask her.
dialogues.text: I put my hand to my throat and ask her.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「でも……ためになりませんから……」
dialogues.en: "But...... it's no good for you."
dialogues.text: "But...... it's no good for you."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「固い事言わずに」
dialogues.en: "Don't be too argumentative."
dialogues.text: "Don't be too argumentative."

dialogues.jp: 顔の前で片手を立てる。
dialogues.en: I hold up my hand in front of her face.
dialogues.text: I hold up my hand in front of her face.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「分かりました……。でも、今度は忘れちゃ、
　駄目ですよ……」
dialogues.en: "Okay...... But don't forget your homework next time......"
dialogues.text: "Okay...... But don't forget your homework next time......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "I won't."
dialogues.text: "I won't."

dialogues.jp:
二人は同じ宿題を出されている。そう、俺達は
同じクラスなのだ。
dialogues.en: We have the same homework. Yes, we have the same classes.
dialogues.text: We have the same homework. Yes, we have the same classes.

dialogues.jp:
同じ学園に通い、同じ教室に席を持ち、そして、
誰にもはばかるところのない恋人同士で……。
dialogues.en:
We go to the same school, sit together in the same
classroom, and everybody knows we are a couple.
dialogues.text:
We go to the same school, sit together in the same
classroom, and everybody knows we are a couple.

dialogues.jp: 毎日が楽しくて。
dialogues.en: Every day is fun.
dialogues.text: Every day is fun.

dialogues.jp: 休み時間でも放課後でも楽しくて。
dialogues.en: It's always fun, even between break times and after school.
dialogues.text: It's always fun, even between break times and after school.

dialogues.jp:
二人、にこにこと笑っていて。たまに、キスな
んか交わしたりして。
dialogues.en: We are smiling. And we sometimes kiss.
dialogues.text: We are smiling. And we sometimes kiss.

dialogues.jp: そんな、幸せな夢。
dialogues.en: This is such a happy dream.
dialogues.text: This is such a happy dream.

dialogues.jp: そんな、誰かの幸せな夢を、俺は見ていた──。
dialogues.en: I was in someone's happy dream.
dialogues.text: I was in someone's happy dream.

dialogues.jp: ◆幸せな夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆---- This is a dream.◆
dialogues.text: ◆---- This is a dream.◆

dialogues.jp: 誰かの夢を見ていた。
dialogues.en:
I'm having a dream. No... I should say I'm being forced to
have a dream.
dialogues.text:
I'm having a dream. No... I should say I'm being forced to
have a dream.

dialogues.jp:
夢の中の『俺』は学生で、傍らには｛・・／恋人｝の頼子
さんがいて……。
dialogues.en:
It's been a long time since the last time my supernatural
power was activated.
dialogues.text:
It's been a long time since the last time my supernatural
power was activated.

dialogues.jp:
二人はクラスメイトで、楽しい学園生活、楽し
い毎日。
dialogues.en:
My sleep's so deep that I can't move my body. I can't do
anything but let my body float.
dialogues.text:
My sleep's so deep that I can't move my body. I can't do
anything but let my body float.

dialogues.jp: そんな、幸せな夢
dialogues.en: Drift to a world of someone's dream......
dialogues.text: Drift to a world of someone's dream......
